question: Provide the full names of drivers who have been overtaken on track more times than they have overtaken others on track during race laps, excluding position changes due to pit stops (both at pit entry and exit), retirements, or position changes that occurred during the first lap of a race (considered as start movements).
sql:
WITH driver_race_info AS (
  SELECT 
    r.race_id,
    r.driver_id,
    r.laps as race_laps
  FROM results r
),
lap_deltas AS (
  SELECT 
    lp.race_id,
    lp.driver_id,
    lp.lap,
    lp.position,
    LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) as prev_position,
    CASE WHEN lp.position < LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as overtaking,
    CASE WHEN lp.position > LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as being_overtaken
  FROM lap_positions lp
  WHERE lp.lap >= 1 AND lp.position IS NOT NULL
),
all_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    ld.race_id,
    ld.driver_id,
    ld.lap,
    ld.position,
    ld.prev_position,
    ld.overtaking,
    ld.being_overtaken,
    dr.race_laps
  FROM lap_deltas ld
  JOIN driver_race_info dr ON ld.race_id = dr.race_id AND ld.driver_id = dr.driver_id
  WHERE ld.position != ld.prev_position
    AND ld.lap > 1
    AND ld.lap <= dr.race_laps
),
pit_exits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    ps.race_id,
    ps.driver_id,
    ps.lap + 1 as exit_lap
  FROM pit_stops ps
  WHERE ps.lap + 1 IN (SELECT lap FROM lap_positions WHERE race_id = ps.race_id AND driver_id = ps.driver_id)
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.*
  FROM all_changes ac
  LEFT JOIN pit_exits pe ON ac.race_id = pe.race_id AND ac.driver_id = pe.driver_id AND ac.lap = pe.exit_lap
  WHERE pe.exit_lap IS NULL  -- Exclude pit exit laps
)
SELECT 
  driver_id,
  SUM(overtaking) as overtaked_others,
  SUM(being_overtaken) as overtaken_count,
  SUM(overtaking) - SUM(being_overtaken) as net_overtakes
FROM filtered
GROUP BY driver_id
HAVING SUM(being_overtaken) > SUM(overtaking)
ORDER BY overtaken_count DESC
LIMIT 30
